uses:actions/checkout: the lane worktree at HEAD with full history; the hosted run checks out the PR merge into the base tip, whose tree is HEAD's while dev stays at the PR base
uses:actions/cache: treated as a cache hit: the pinned tool or cache exists on this host
uses:actions/download-artifact: not downloaded: the aggregate reads this replay's own shard outputs
uses:actions/setup-python: the replay venv's CPython 3.12.13 (uv) is first on PATH

set -euo pipefail
# runner provisioning: librsvg2-bin is installed on this host, so the sudo apt-get lines are replaced by a presence check

Install the pinned sv2v release:
set -euo pipefail
# runner provisioning: the same pinned release and digest; installed into the replay's own bin directory (first on PATH) instead of sudo install to /usr/local/bin
ver=v0.0.12
sha256=ff8c9eea5bc029b372fb4953427625cddb7cf7e58c1240623ac9f260818d5a00
url="https://github.com/zachjs/sv2v/releases/download/${ver}/sv2v-Linux.zip"
curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/sv2v.zip"
echo "${sha256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/sv2v.zip" | sha256sum -c -
unzip -q -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/sv2v.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/sv2v"
install -m755 "$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP/sv2v" -name sv2v -type f | head -1)" @BIN@/sv2v
sv2v --version

Strip git metadata, then run the docs ga:
set -euo pipefail
# the step deletes .git; here it runs in a git-archive export of HEAD (no .git, submodule paths empty as in a checkout without submodules), so the lane worktree keeps its metadata
d="$RUNNER_TEMP/nogit"
mkdir -p "$d"
git archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -x -C "$d"
cd "$d"
test ! -e .git
python3 scripts/docs_check.py
python3 scripts/check_feature_status.py
